name: greeter
description: Single-endpoint reference service: GET /hello returns a JSON greeting addressed to a name query parameter, or a generic greeting when name is omitted. Stateless — no persistence, no auth, no rate limiting, and no endpoint other than /hello. Built to the structure and error-shape conventions in app-factory-kaj/e2e-reference (cmd/+internal layout, net/http, JSON errors). Language is Go because the PRD's Solution explicitly specifies a Go HTTP service, overriding the organization's Ballerina default for services.
